test_cases.title: Registration - Card 1 Password Policy Compliance
test_cases.preconditions: Game page is opened in a fresh browser session; Card 1 is displayed (page indicator shows '1 / 4')

steps.action: Enter the password from test data. Password policy: at least 10 characters, at least 1 uppercase letter, at least 1 numeral
steps.expected_result: Password field contains the entered value

steps.action: Enter email name and email domain from test data, select the email extension from the dropdown
steps.expected_result: Email name and domain fields are populated; selected extension is displayed in the dropdown

steps.action: Accept Terms & Conditions by unchecking the 'I do not accept the Terms & Conditions' checkbox (checked by default)
steps.expected_result: Checkbox is unchecked; no Terms & Conditions error is displayed
Card 2 (avatar and interests) is opened; page indicator shows '2 / 4'

test_cases.title: Registration - Card 1 Email Domain Extensions
test_cases.preconditions: Game page is opened in a fresh browser session; Card 1 is displayed (page indicator shows '1 / 4')

steps.action: Enter the password, email name and email domain from test data
steps.expected_result: Password, email name and domain fields are populated

steps.action: Select the current email extension from the test data list in the dropdown
steps.expected_result: Selected extension is displayed in the dropdown

steps.action: Accept Terms & Conditions by unchecking the 'I do not accept the Terms & Conditions' checkbox (checked by default)
steps.expected_result: Checkbox is unchecked; no Terms & Conditions error is displayed
Card 2 is opened; page indicator shows '2 / 4'

steps.action: Reload the game page and repeat steps 1-4 for every remaining extension in the test data list
steps.expected_result: Each of the 10 email extensions is accepted and Card 2 is opened every time

test_cases.title: Cookies Consent - Dismiss Cookies Banner
test_cases.preconditions: Game page is opened in a fresh browser session

steps.action: Wait for the cookies banner to appear at the top of the page
steps.expected_result: Banner 'This site uses cookies, is that a problem for you?' is displayed shortly after page load with 'Not really, no' and 'Yes' buttons
Cookies banner is closed and no longer displayed on the page

test_cases.title: Game Session - Timer Start and Increment
test_cases.preconditions: Browser session is started; game page is not opened yet

steps.expected_result: Timer is displayed in the page header and starts from 00:00:00 (format HH:MM:SS)

steps.action: Observe the timer value for several seconds
steps.expected_result: Timer value increases by 1 second every second
